# Silvaneo Vieira dos Santos Junior

<p class="position">Ph.D. Student in Statistics &amp; Data Science<br><span>The University of Texas at Austin</span></p>

<p class="hero-summary">I develop Bayesian methods for data that arrive or evolve over time, with current interests in <strong>Bayesian sequential methods</strong>, <strong>causal inference for surrogate evaluation</strong>, and <strong>Bayesian nonparametrics</strong>. My work focuses on statistical methods that remain flexible, principled, and computationally practical as information accumulates.</p>
